Before you upload

  1. Use the clearest source available; enlarging a tiny image cannot restore lost detail.
  2. Choose fewer colors for simple logos and more for illustrations.
  3. Inspect lettering and edges after tracing.
  4. Open the downloaded file in your intended design software before production.
